additional_info.subject: RE: ID0380108-DC/Si-D/AR-[MP / P9 170000994] Converter not found - CanCommLoss CRM:00797001254
additional_info.body:
Hi Sofia,
Upon receiving your email confirmation, I am proceeding with closing the case.
However, I need to inform you that the power converter missing error persists on the charger. Moreover, the charger is running on an older firmware version V3.2.8 and has been out of warranty since January 2024.
If the customer agrees to cover the expenses for a site visit and component replacement, I recommend replacing the defective converter or conducting a wiring check. Additionally, it is advisable to update the charger to the latest firmware version, v4.11.0. If you prefer to update the firmware remotely, please open a new ticket for this purpose.
This ticket will now be closed. You will receive a survey email shortly for your feedback.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Sharma
